# React & Next.js performance (Vercel)

Vercel's ranked rules for faster React and Next.js code: waterfalls, bundles, rendering.

- Source: https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills/main/skills/react-best-practices/SKILL.md
- Author: Vercel
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/react-next-js-performance-vercel-f9bf3208

A large rule set from Vercel engineering that Claude applies when writing, reviewing or refactoring React and Next.js code. Rules are grouped by impact, starting with removing request waterfalls and shrinking bundles, then server-side performance, data fetching, re-renders and rendering. Each rule lives in its own file with bad and good examples, and a compiled AGENTS.md version is included.

**Try asking:**
- "Review this Next.js page for performance problems"
- "Why is my bundle so big? Fix it"
- "Refactor this component to avoid unnecessary re-renders"
